  have mono : ∀ k, L p q k ≤ L p q (k+1) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      show L p q 0 ≤ L p q 1
      simp [L]
    | succ k ih =>
      have h0 : 1 * L p q (k+1) ≤ p * L p q (k+1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul hp (Nat.le_refl (L p q (k+1)))
      rw [Nat.one_mul] at h0
      show L p q (k+1) ≤ L p q (k+2)
      rw [L_succ_succ p q k]
      exact Nat.le_trans h0 (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  have mono2 : ∀ d a, L p q a ≤ L p q (a + d) := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero =>
      intro a
      exact Nat.le_refl _
    | succ d ih =>
      intro a
      show L p q a ≤ L p q (a + d + 1)
      exact Nat.le_trans (ih a) (mono (a + d))
  have memb : ∀ n m y, y ∈ firstN (fun i => L p q (i + (m+1))) n → L p q m ≤ y := by
    intro n m y hy
    unfold firstN at hy
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hy
    subst hi
    show L p q m ≤ L p q (i + (m+1))
    have h2 := mono2 (i+1) m
    rw [show i + (m+1) = m + (i+1) by omega]
    exact h2
  have hs : ∀ (n : Nat) (g : Nat → Nat), firstN g (n+1) = g 0 :: firstN (fun i => g (i+1)) n := by
    intro n g
    unfold firstN
    rw [List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.map_map]
    all_goals rfl
  have ins_lem : ∀ (l : List Nat) (x : Nat), (∀ y ∈ l, x ≤ y) → ins x l = x :: l := by
    intro l x h
    cases l with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons y ys =>
      have hxy : x ≤ y := h y (by simp)
      show (if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: ins x ys) = x :: y :: ys
      rw [if_pos hxy]
  have key : ∀ n m, isort (firstN (fun i => L p q (i + m)) n) = firstN (fun i => L p q (i + m)) n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro m
      simp [firstN, isort]
    | succ k ih =>
      intro m
      rw [hs k (fun i => L p q (i + m))]
      show isort (L p q (0 + m) :: firstN (fun i => L p q (i + 1 + m)) k) = L p q (0 + m) :: firstN (fun i => L p q (i + 1 + m)) k
      have hf : firstN (fun i => L p q (i + 1 + m)) k = firstN (fun i => L p q (i + (m + 1))) k := by
        unfold firstN
        congr 1
        funext i
        exact congrArg (L p q) (by omega)
      rw [Nat.zero_add, hf]
      have hcons : isort (L p q m :: firstN (fun i => L p q (i + (m+1))) k) = ins (L p q m) (isort (firstN (fun i => L p q (i + (m+1))) k)) := rfl
      rw [hcons, ih (m+1), ins_lem (firstN (fun i => L p q (i + (m+1))) k) (L p q m) (fun y hy => memb k m y hy)]

    fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl
  have hS1 : ∀ x, Sorted [x] := by
    intro x; simp [Sorted]
  have hS0 : Sorted [] := by simp [Sorted]
  have htail : ∀ x l, Sorted (x :: l) → Sorted l := by
    intro x l h
    cases l with
    | nil => exact hS0
    | cons w ws => exact ((hS2 x w ws).mp h).2
  have hcins : ∀ x a l, cnt a (ins x l) = (if x = a then 1 else 0) + cnt a l := by
    intro x a l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp [ins, cnt]
    | cons y ys ih =>
      by_cases hxy : x ≤ y
      · simp [ins, hxy, cnt] <;> omega
      · simp [ins, hxy, cnt, ih] <;> omega
  have hcisort : ∀ a l, cnt a (isort l) = cnt a l := by
    intro a l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp [isort, cnt]
    | cons x xs ih => simp [isort, hcins, cnt, ih] <;> omega
  have hsins : ∀ x l, Sorted l → Sorted (ins x l) := by
    intro x l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro _; simp [ins, Sorted]
    | cons y ys ih =>
      intro hs
      by_cases hxy : x ≤ y
      · have e : ins x (y :: ys) = x :: y :: ys := by simp [ins, hxy]
        rw [e]
        exact (hS2 x y ys).mpr ⟨hxy, hs⟩
      · have e : ins x (y :: ys) = y :: ins x ys := by simp [ins, hxy]
        rw [e]
        cases ys with
        | nil =>
          have e2 : ins x [] = [x] := by simp [ins]
          rw [e2]
          exact (hS2 y x []).mpr ⟨by omega, hS1 x⟩
        | cons w ws =>
          have hs2 : y ≤ w ∧ Sorted (w :: ws) := (hS2 y w ws).mp hs
          have ih2 : Sorted (ins x (w :: ws)) := ih hs2.2
          by_cases hxw : x ≤ w
          · have e3 : ins x (w :: ws) = x :: w :: ws := by simp [ins, hxw]
            rw [e3]
            exact (hS2 y x (w :: ws)).mpr ⟨by omega, (hS2 x w ws).mpr ⟨hxw, hs2.2⟩⟩

            rw [e4] at ih2

      by_cases hwz : w = z
      · subst hwz; exact hs2.1
      · have h' : cnt z ws ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          apply h
          simp [cnt, hwz, h0]
        have := ih w z hs2.2 h'
        omega

    intro l1
    induction l1 with
    | nil =>
      intro l2 _ _ hc
      cases l2 with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons y ys =>
        have h := hc y
        simp [cnt] at h <;> omega
    | cons x xs ih =>
      intro l2 hs1 hs2 hc
      cases l2 with
      | nil =>
        have h := hc x
        simp [cnt] at h <;> omega
      | cons y ys =>
        have e1 : cnt x (x :: xs) = 1 + cnt x xs := by simp [cnt]
        have e2 : cnt y (y :: ys) = 1 + cnt y ys := by simp [cnt]
        have hne1 : cnt x (y :: ys) ≠ 0 := by
          have := hc x
          omega
        have hne2 : cnt y (x :: xs) ≠ 0 := by
          have := hc y
          omega
        have h1 : x = y ∨ y ≤ x := by
          by_cases hxy : x = y
          · exact Or.inl hxy
          · right
            apply hhead ys y x hs2
            have e3 : cnt x (y :: ys) = cnt x ys := by simp [cnt, Ne.symm hxy]
            rw [← e3]
            exact hne1

          · exact Or.inl hyx
          · right

            have e4 : cnt y (x :: xs) = cnt y xs := by simp [cnt, Ne.symm hyx]
            rw [← e4]
            exact hne2

          intro a
          have h := hc a
          simp only [cnt] at h
          rw [hxy] at h
          omega
        rw [hxy, htl]

    induction m with
    | nil => simp [isort, Sorted]
    | cons x xs ih =>

      exact hsins x (isort xs) ih

    intro a
    rw [← hcisort a l, ← hcisort a l', h]

    intro a
    rw [hcisort a l, hcisort a l']

    | nil => rfl

      · rw [if_pos hxy] <;> rfl
      · rw [if_neg hxy]
        show (if y = a then 1 else 0) + cnt a (ins x ys) = (if x = a then 1 else 0) + ((if y = a then 1 else 0) + cnt a ys)
        rw [ih']
        omega

    induction ls with
    | nil => rfl

      have h1 := hcisort l a

      rw [h] at h1
